dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですか！？」
dialogues.en: "Really!?"
dialogues.text: "Really!?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ。その意外そうな声と顔は」
dialogues.en: "What's with that shocked expression."
dialogues.text: "What's with that shocked expression."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、美春はなにも思ってないですよ。バナ
　ナには誓えませんけど、神に誓って美春はそ
　んなことは思ってません」
dialogues.en:
"N, no, I wasn't thinking that! I swear on my bananas and
God, I wasn't thinking anything like that!"
dialogues.text:
"N, no, I wasn't thinking that! I swear on my bananas and
God, I wasn't thinking anything like that!"

dialogues.jp: ホント、わかりやすいやつだ。
dialogues.en: She's way too easy to read.
dialogues.text: She's way too easy to read.

dialogues.jp: 「どりゃ……」
dialogues.en: "Here I go..."
dialogues.text: "Here I go..."

dialogues.jp:
木の幹に足を引っ掛け、慎重に登る。木登りな
んて久しぶりだ。
dialogues.en:
I stick my foot firmly into the tree trunk, and carefully
start climbing. It's been a long time since I've climbed a
tree.
dialogues.text:
I stick my foot firmly into the tree trunk, and carefully
start climbing. It's been a long time since I've climbed a
tree.

dialogues.jp: 「よっと」
dialogues.en: "Hup!"
dialogues.text: "Hup!"

dialogues.jp: 猫のいる枝に｛たど／辿｝り着き、手を伸ばす。
dialogues.en:
I get to the branch which the cat was clinging on to, and
reach my hand out.
dialogues.text:
I get to the branch which the cat was clinging on to, and
reach my hand out.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、おいで」
dialogues.en: "Come on, don't be scared."
dialogues.text: "Come on, don't be scared."

dialogues.jp: 美春の前で、こっぱずかしいセリフをはく。
dialogues.en:
In front of Miharu, I felt a little embarassed saying such
things.
dialogues.text:
In front of Miharu, I felt a little embarassed saying such
things.

dialogues.jp: 伸ばした手に暖かなぬくもりを感じ、腕を引く。
dialogues.en:
Feeling the warmth generated by my hand, the cat climbed
onto it.
dialogues.text:
Feeling the warmth generated by my hand, the cat climbed
onto it.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「｛さすが／流石｝は朝倉先輩。困っているヒトを見過ごせ
　ませんね」
dialogues.en:
"You're great, Asakura-senpai! You're definitely not one to
hold regrets!"
dialogues.text:
"You're great, Asakura-senpai! You're definitely not one to
hold regrets!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「人じゃないけどな」
dialogues.en: "I'm not that kind of person at all..."
dialogues.text: "I'm not that kind of person at all..."

dialogues.jp: 照れ隠しに、呟いてみる。
dialogues.en: Trying to hide my obviously red face, I murmur those words.
dialogues.text: Trying to hide my obviously red face, I murmur those words.

dialogues.jp: 「ほれ」
dialogues.en: "Off you go."
dialogues.text: "Off you go."

dialogues.jp: 腕に抱いていた猫を、地面にはなしてやる。
dialogues.en: I let the cat, clinging on to my chest, drop onto the floor.
dialogues.text: I let the cat, clinging on to my chest, drop onto the floor.

dialogues.jp:
地上に降り立った猫は、何度か振り返ると、タッ
タッと駆けていった。
dialogues.en:
As it started walking off, it turned it's head back a few
times, then dashed off.
dialogues.text:
As it started walking off, it turned it's head back a few
times, then dashed off.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ俺はもう行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "I'd be going now."
dialogues.text: "I'd be going now."

dialogues.jp: 美春に背を向け、公園の出口に向かう。
dialogues.en: I head past Miharu, towards the park's exit.
dialogues.text: I head past Miharu, towards the park's exit.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい。お達者で〜」
dialogues.en: "Okay. See you again!"
dialogues.text: "Okay. See you again!"

dialogues.jp:
背後から、やたらめったら元気な声が聞こえて
いた。
dialogues.en:
From behind me, I could hear the blindly cheerful voice
bidding me farewell.
dialogues.text:
From behind me, I could hear the blindly cheerful voice
bidding me farewell.

dialogues.jp: さて、そんな、うららかな春の日曜の午後。
dialogues.en: Indeed, that was a beautiful Sunday of spring.
dialogues.text: Indeed, that was a beautiful Sunday of spring.

dialogues.jp:
枯れなくなった桜の木から、降りられなくなっ
た１匹の猫を助けたこと。
dialogues.en:
From a branch of the immortal sakura tree, I saved a cat and
brought it back down to earth.
dialogues.text:
From a branch of the immortal sakura tree, I saved a cat and
brought it back down to earth.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことは、従姉の帰国や、音夢の進学のご
たごたの中で俺の記憶からすっぽり抜けていた。
dialogues.en:
That happening, as well as my cousin returning from the
states, and Nemu moving to college overseas, all remain some
of my treasured memories.
dialogues.text:
That happening, as well as my cousin returning from the
states, and Nemu moving to college overseas, all remain some
of my treasured memories.

dialogues.jp:
そして、退屈な卒業式と春休みを独り身で通り
過ぎて。
dialogues.en:
Meanwhile, after graduation, I idly let time pass through
the spring break.
dialogues.text:
Meanwhile, after graduation, I idly let time pass through
the spring break.

dialogues.en: 8th of April--。
dialogues.text: 8th of April--。

dialogues.jp: 俺の新しい学園生活が始まる。
dialogues.en: My new school life begins now.
dialogues.text: My new school life begins now.

dialogues.jp: ◆俺が猫を救出◆
dialogues.en: ◆Saving the cat◆
dialogues.text: ◆Saving the cat◆

dialogues.jp:
面倒だが仕方がない。俺は、猫を助けてやる事
にした。
dialogues.en:
Even if it's troublesome, it can't be helped. I decide to,
and save the cat.
dialogues.text:
Even if it's troublesome, it can't be helped. I decide to,
and save the cat.
